name: Teen Academy (summer art classes)
what_you_do: Take one-week studio classes in drawing, painting, filmmaking, photography, fashion design, creative writing and more, and build a portfolio.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 18 years old. Students can join one week, all six or any number of weeks.
pay_detail: $185 per one-week course (Week 3 is $148). Morning (9 to 11:30 a.m.) and afternoon (12:30 to 3 p.m.) courses.
duration: Six weeks of themed courses (2026: June 1 to July 24)
deadline_text: The page shows the 2026 course schedule. 2027 dates and registration are not posted.
how_to_apply: Register for classes through the registration link on the Teen Academy page. Questions: Office of Engagement.
notes: Courses change every week. Students agree to the handbook rules when they sign up. The page mentions scholarships; ask the Office of Engagement for details.
